In your answer, give the figure you read for each named listing, then answer the question from those figures. Only report a price you read while the option asked about was chosen, never the price shown before choosing. Say which pages you opened.
A size's label in the menu can carry promotional or stock text; the price is the one shown after the size is chosen, and a label's claim is not a checked fact.

result.final: No — the claim in the size menu is not what XS costs. For the Elmsworth Textiles Official Store listing (http://localhost:7770/igr-tcl-19.html), the size menu label reads 'XS - Promo $28.55', but after selecting size XS in the menu, the page price changes from 'As low as $26.99' to $32.95. So size XS on that listing costs $32.95, not $28.55. Only the 1 named listing was opened (Elmsworth Textiles Official Store, igr-tcl-19.html), after loading the search results page. Figures read after choosing XS: Elmsworth Textiles Official Store — $32.95.
